runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: 13:05 diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress/Reddit communities and public Facebook indexing. No new candidate cleared profile/economic/activity gates. jobs-data.json remained fail-closed and unchanged.

developmentChanges.title: Client last-view hard stale gate
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance listings, distinguish listing freshness from buyer activity and automatically demote jobs whose client has not viewed the post for multiple weeks even when the page remains indexed.

developmentChanges.title: Fixed-price scope sanity gate
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate whether a fixed-price freelance budget is plausible for the described deliverables and suppress obvious underpriced work before it consumes application time.
